title: Uka Arupax Nina Q’añut uñt’atawa
intro: Mä jach’a jaqin identidadap uñakipaña, jupax saräwipax mä milagro uñt’asiwimpiw qalltawayi, ukat destinopax mä t’aqhisiyat jaqinakan qhispiyasiñapampix ch’amanchatawa. Aka jaqix mä jach’a lurawitak ajllitänwa, jach’a jan walt’awinakampiw uñjasiwayi, Diosan yanapt’apampi.
clues: Nayajj wali tʼaqhesiyat tiemponwa nasta, ukanjja markajan jiskʼa wawanakapwa jiwayapjjäna.
Nayra jakäwijanjja, awk taykajajj mä jawir uchatänwa, ukampis markajan tʼaqhesiyiripan utapanwa jikjjatasiyäta ukat jilsuwayta.
Mä kutejja, chʼajjwañ horasan mä jaqerojj jan amuytʼasisaw jiwayayäta, ukatwa mä markat jaltjjayäta.
Diosan mä yatiyäwipa ukat mä milagro thujru mä qullan chiqan katuqta, ukanwa mä chʼamani apnaqirimpi uñkatasiñajatak kamachitäna.
Jilajax misión ukan yanapiripjamaw utt’ayatäna, kunatix arst’äwijanx mä jark’atäkaspas ukhamaw amuyasïna.
Mä tʼaqa tʼaqa lamar qotaruw markajarojj irpjjayäta, mä tirano ejercito arknaqañat qhespiyasa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
